content.title: Graco SnugRide Turn & Slide Recall
content.text: Recall Landing Page Important Safety Notice for Select Graco® SnugRide® Turn & Slide Products At Graco, the safety of children and the trust of parents and caregivers are at the heart of everything we do. We are conducting a voluntary recall of select SnugRide Turn & Slide products due to a structural issue identified during a post-production laboratory test. This recall affects a limited number of SnugRide Turn & Slide products sold in the United States from January 2026 through March 2026 at Amazon, Babylist, Target, Walmart and on GracoBaby.com. No other Graco rotating car seats are affected, including EasyTurn and Turn2Me. No other SnugRide models are affected. We know parents rely on Graco products every day, and we understand this may create frustration and disruption for families. We are working quickly to support affected families and will provide a replacement product at no cost. If you own a SnugRide Turn & Slide product, please review the information below to confirm whether your product is included and complete the recall registration process. Recall Overview Availability window Sold in the United States from January 2026 through March 2026 Retailers Amazon, Babylist, Target, Walmart and GracoBaby.com Recall scope Only select SnugRide® Turn & Slide products are included Not affected EasyTurn, Turn2Me and all other SnugRide models Products Included in This Recall This recall applies only to select SnugRide Turn & Slide products. Color names are included for reference, but the model number is the best way to confirm whether your product is included. Product Affected Model Number(s) Recall Notes Infant Car Seats SnugRide® Turn & Slide Rotating Infant Car Seat 2231809 Noir / Black 2231887 Sandstone / Tan 2231806 Mulberry / Girl-Plum 2231885 Sandstone / Tan 2231881 Noir / Black 2231884 Noir / Black Replacement product available at no cost for affected consumers after registration review. Car Seat Base SnugRide® Turn & Slide Rotating Infant Car Seat Base 2231810 Black Included only when the product label matches the affected model number listed here. Travel System Modes™ Nest Travel System with SnugRide® Turn & Slide ICS 2243083 Noir / Black The stroller is not affected. Both infant car seat replacement options are designed to work with your existing travel system stroller. This recall is limited to the recently introduced SnugRide Turn & Slide model. No other Graco rotating car seats are affected, including EasyTurn and Turn2Me. No other SnugRide models are affected. How to Check if Your Product Is Included Review the product images on this page to confirm that you have a SnugRide Turn & Slide product. Locate your model number on the product label. Enter your model number on this page. Enter your serial number to help confirm your product details. The serial number is the five digit number listed on the label under the Date of Manufacture. The label on the base includes the product name, model number, date of manufacture, and serial number. The serial number appears directly below the words “Date of Manufacture.” The label on the base includes the product name, model number, date of manufacture and serial number. The serial number appears directly below the words “Date of Manufacture.” What You Should Do if Your Product Is Included 1. Stop Using the Seat with the Base Stop using the seat with the base. The current seat may continue to be used without the base in accordance with the product instructions while you wait for your selected replacement product. 2. Document the Product Remove the seat from the base and locate the label on the base showing the model number, date of manufacture, and serial number. Upload a clear photo of the white label on the base showing the model number, date of manufacture, and serial number 3. Complete Registration Complete the registration form and select your preferred replacement option. Please do not return the product to a store. Quick Model Check Enter the model number shown on your product label to confirm whether it is part of this recall. Your model number is located on the base of the seat. Replacement Options Graco will provide affected consumers with one of the following replacement options at no cost. Infant car seat options Option 1 SnugRide SnugFit DLX Maison (2156211) + additional SnugRide SnugFit base (2120612) Option 2 SnugRide SnugFit Gotham (2121500) + additional SnugRide SnugFit base (2120612) Toddler seat options Option 3 EasyTurn Solae (2216076) Option 4 Turn2Me Brighton (2215409) If you are registering a base-only product (model 2231810), you will receive SnugRide SnugFit base (2120612) only. Base-only registrations are not eligible for full car seat replacement options. Once you submit your information, we will review your registration and verify whether you are affected. If affected, we will then process your selected replacement option. Registration Form Complete the information below to continue to the Graco registration form, where you will upload your required photos and complete the remaining registration details. Continue to the Graco registration form On the next step, you will be asked to upload a clear photo of the white label on the base showing the model number, date of manufacture, and serial number. Affected model number Date of manufacture Serial number Enter the five digit serial number listed under the Date of Manufacture on the base label. Replacement option Before you continue Stop using the seat with the base, have a clear photo of the white label on the base ready, and have your selected replacement option ready before moving to the next step. On the Graco registration form, you will be asked to provide your first name, last name, email address, phone number, street address, city, state, ZIP code, model number, serial number, date of manufacture, label photo and selected replacement option. Photo of the date of manufacture label on the base showing the model number, date of manufacture, and serial number Frequently Asked Questions Why is this product being recalled? At Graco, the safety of children is our top priority. We are conducting this voluntary recall due to a structural issue identified during a post-production laboratory test. We understand this may be concerning, and we are taking this step to support families and maintain confidence in our products. How do I know if my product is included? The best way to check is by locating your model number and comparing it to the affected products listed on this page. You will also be asked to provide your serial number to help confirm your product details. What should I do if I own an affected product? If your product is included in the recall, stop using the seat with the base. The current seat may continue to be used without the base in accordance with the product instructions while you wait for your selected replacement product. You should then follow the instructions on this page to document the product, upload the required photo, and complete your registration. Can I continue to use my product? You should stop using the seat with the base. The current seat may continue to be used without the base in accordance with the product instructions while you wait for your selected replacement product. What photos do I need to upload? You will be asked to upload a photo of the label on the base showing the model number, date of manufacture, and serial number. Where do I find the date of manufacture and serial number? The date of manufacture and serial number are located on the label on the base. You may need to remove the seat from the base to access it. The five digit serial number appears directly below the words “Date of Manufacture.” Can I throw the product away? Once you have received confirmation that your product is included in the recall and you have received the replacement, you may dispose of the affected product. What will Graco provide to affected consumers? Graco will provide a replacement product at no cost. As part of the registration process, you will be able to select from the available replacement options listed on this page. Do I need to return my product to a store? No. Please do not return the product to a store. Is the stroller included in the recall? No. For the affected travel system, the stroller is not included in this recall. Will the replacement product work with my Modes™ Nest Travel System stroller? Yes. Both infant car seat replacement options are designed to work with your existing travel system stroller. Helpful Links and Support If you have questions, please contact our Graco Consumer Services team via chat, email or by phone at 1-800-345-4109 between 9 a.m. – 5 p.m. ET, Monday thru Friday.
